en: Black‑and‑white image showing a tranquil riverside or mill pond scene in a rural European town. In the foreground three people stand and sit on a simple flat boat tethered to the shore. Across the water is a wooden dam or weir, timber buildings including a half‑timbered house, and a large multi‑storey white industrial building with a small cupola on the roof, likely a factory, brewery, or mill. Trees and low hills surround the settlement, and a bench and tree with posted notices appear on the right edge.
